title: Thumbelina
description: A tiny girl born inside a flower is swept far from home and must find her own way through rivers, forests, winter tunnels and finally a warm land of flowers.
catalogueBlurb: A tiny girl crosses a huge world to find a place where she belongs.

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on Hans Christian Andersen's 1835 tale Tommelise (Thumbelina)
text.notes: Hans Christian Andersen's underlying 1835 story is public domain. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.
